thread:
Ava (Content): kicking off the Edge Deploy Kit community launch — want an OSS blog, a short benchmark note, a 45-min webinar + 30-min hands-on lab, and a dev-centered tweet thread.
Priya (DevRel): agree. Lab must be 20–30m: repo walkthrough, local run, small perf check. Keep steps copy-paste.
Liam (PM): benchmark narrative: p90 @512 tokens, median tokens/sec, and cost comparison vs hosted on small batches. Claims must be reproducible.
Noah (SRE): I'll run bench matrix on a GPU test node and a CPU-edge sim, upload CSV + tiny charts. Will prepare docker image + single-file k8s manifest. Bench snippet:
```
export RW_API_KEY="$RW_KEY"
./bench/edge-bench --model rwd-mini --tokens 512 --concurrency 4
```
Evelyn (Growth): Landing page needs utm=oss_edge_launch and HubSpot wiring. Promo plan: organic + paid day-of, two reminders, post-webinar nurture. Need short tweet thread + 2 exec quotes.
Ava (Content): Draft headline idea: "Edge Deploy Kit — lightweight starter for private LLM inference." I'll draft blog + 3-part tweet thread by EOD Friday.
Priya (DevRel): Speakers: Priya + Liam + Noah. Agenda: 20-min demo, 15-min bench walkthrough, 10-min Q&A, 30-min optional lab breakout. Record for YT and add repo actions.
launch-bot: Reminder: schedule webinar at least 3 weeks out with template "webinar-standard".
Evelyn (Growth): HubSpot flow: utm_source=oss_edge_launch -> list "OSS Edge Registrants"; attended -> tag oss_edge:attended; >2 opens -> mark warm and notify AE.
Ava (Content): demo snippet for blog:
```
docker run --rm -p 8080:8080 redwood/edge-deploy-kit:latest
curl -sS -X POST http://localhost:8080/generate -d '{"prompt":"Summarize this repo"}'
```
Priya (DevRel): Add troubleshooting: docker errors, CPU fallback, minimal quantized model strategy. Include lab checklist with expected outputs.
Noah (SRE): Posting bench CSV tomorrow AM. I'll also add telemetry example printing latency and tokens/sec.
Ava (Content): Owners recap: Ava -> blog+tweets; Priya -> repo+lab; Noah -> bench+artifacts; Liam -> speaker notes; Evelyn -> landing+HubSpot. I'll compile launch checklist once drafts are up.
Liam (PM): We'll do a dry-run one week before. Ping when drafts ready.
Ava (Content): Any blockers?
Priya (DevRel): Starting repo skeleton now, none.
Noah (SRE): Bench run scheduled tomorrow.
Ava (Content): Great — keeping this thread as source-of-truth. Thanks all :rocket:
